glossary:
GitHub. One command per line: <words> [target] [values] [key=value]. Word order is free; plurals and synonyms are fine (write pr for pull request, repository=repo, show=get, remove=delete, edit=update).
Target: owner/repo or owner/repo#N (issue, PR, discussion or alert number). Org-level lists: owner=ORG. Quote values with spaces. Lists: a,b. JSON arrays go in single quotes: key='[{"a":"b"}]'. Paging: page= perPage= after=.
  repo: create <name> [org= private= init=true] | fork [org=] | star | unstar | watch | ignore | unwatch | search <q> [sort=stars|forks|updated] | starred [user=] | tree [ref= path= recursive=true] | list collaborator [affiliation=outside|direct|all]
  file: get <path> [ref= sha=] | write|create|update <path> content= message= branch= [sha= needed when replacing] | delete <path> message= branch= | push branch= message= files='[{"path":"a","content":"b"}]'
  branch: list | create <name> [from=]   commit: get <sha> [detail=none|stats|full_patch] | list [sha= author= path= since= until=] | search <q>
  tag: get <tag> | list   release: list | get <tag> | latest release
  issue: get | list [state=OPEN|CLOSED labels= orderBy=CREATED_AT|UPDATED_AT|COMMENTS direction=ASC|DESC] | search <q> | create <title> [body= labels= assignees= milestone= type= parent=] | update [title= body= state=open|closed reason=completed|not_planned|duplicate duplicate= labels= assignees=] | close [reason=] | reopen | issue comment|label|parent | issue field|type (owner only ok) | add issue comment <body> [reaction=+1|-1|laugh|confused|heart|hooray|rocket|eyes] | update issue comment <comment_id> <body>
  subissue (target owner/repo#PARENT): list | add <sub_issue_id> [replace=true] | remove <sub_issue_id> | reprioritize <sub_issue_id> after=|before=
  copilot: assign copilot owner/repo#N rationale= confidence=LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH [base= instructions=] | suggest copilot (same keys, records intent only) | launch copilot [base= instructions=] | request copilot review owner/repo#N
  pr: get | pr diff|status|file|commit|review|comment|check | pr review comment (threads) | list [state=open|closed|all base= head= sort=] | search <q> | create <title> head= base= [body= draft=true reviewers=a,b] | update [title= body= base= state=open|closed draft= reviewers=] | close | reopen | merge [method=merge|squash|rebase title= message=] | update pr branch | approve [body=] | add pr comment <body> | update pr comment <comment_id> <body> | reply pr comment <review_comment_id> [<body>] [reaction=]
  review (owner/repo#N): create review [event=APPROVE|REQUEST_CHANGES|COMMENT body=] | submit review event= [body=] | delete review (pending) | add review comment <path> <body> type=FILE|LINE [line= side=LEFT|RIGHT start= startside=] | resolve thread <PRRT_id> | unresolve thread <PRRT_id>
  label: get|create|update|delete <name> [color=hex description= new=] | list
  discussion: get | list [category= orderBy= direction=] | discussion comment [replies=true] | discussion category | add discussion comment <body> | reply|update discussion comment <node_id> <body> | delete discussion comment <node_id> | mark|unmark answer <node_id>
  gist: get <id> | list [user=] | create <filename> <content> [description= public=true] | update <id> filename= content=
  notification: list [filter=default|include_read_notifications|only_participating] | get <id> | dismiss <id> state=read|done | mark all notification read | watch|ignore|unwatch notification <id>
  team: list [user=] | team member <org> <team_slug>   me: get me
  alert: get|list code alert, secret alert, dependabot alert (get uses #N; list [state= severity=]) | code finding #N
  advisory (global): get <GHSA-id> | list [ecosystem=npm|pip|go|maven|... severity= cve= type=reviewed|malware|unreviewed] | list repo advisory | list org advisory <org>
  actions: list workflow | list run [workflow=id|file] | list job <run_id> | list artifact <run_id> | get workflow <id|file> | get run <run_id> | get job <job_id> | download artifact <id> | run usage <run_id> | run log url <run_id> | trigger workflow <id|file> ref= | rerun run <run_id> | rerun failed job <run_id> | cancel run <run_id> | delete run log <run_id> | job log <job_id> [tail= content=true] | failed job log <run_id>
  project (use <owner> <number> values, not a target): list project <owner> | get project | get|list project field|item|view|status update | create project <owner> <title> type=user|org | add project item <owner> <n> owner/repo#N type=issue|pull_request [pr=] | delete project item <owner> <n> <item_id> | create project status update status=ON_TRACK|AT_RISK|OFF_TRACK|COMPLETE|INACTIVE [body=] | create|update|delete project view [name= layout=table|board|roadmap] | create iteration field name= duration= start=
  ruleset (level=repository|organization|enterprise, plus org= or enterprise=): list | get <id> | branch rule <branch> | list|get rule suite | create <name> enforcement=active|disabled|evaluate rules='[{"type":"deletion"}]'
  property (custom properties): get level= | set level= properties='[{"property_name":"team","value":"core"}]'
  ui owner/repo data=labels|assignees|milestones|issue_types|branches|issue_fields|reviewers; list milestone|assignee|reviewer
Examples:
merge pr octo/app#10 method=squash
get pr files octo/app#10
create issue octo/app "Login fails" labels=bug,auth
list runs octo/app workflow=ci.yml

commands.example: search issues "login fails after password reset" octo/app

commands.usage: write file owner/repo <path> content= message= branch= [sha=]
commands.example: write file octo/app docs/a.md content="Hello world" message="Add doc" branch=main

commands.usage: create file owner/repo <path> content= message= branch=
commands.example: create file octo/app docs/b.md content="New page" message="Add page" branch=main

commands.usage: update file owner/repo <path> content= message= branch= sha=
commands.example: update file octo/app docs/a.md content="Updated" message="Update doc" branch=main sha=abc123
delete file octo/app old.txt message="Remove old" branch=main

commands.usage: push file owner/repo branch= message= files='[{"path":..,"content":..}]'
commands.example: push files octo/app branch=main message="Add files" files='[{"path":"a.txt","content":"A"},{"path":"b.txt","content":"B"}]'
list commits octo/app sha=main author=alice since=2026-01-01
create issue octo/app "Login fails" labels=bug,auth body="Steps to reproduce"
update issue octo/app#5 title="Login fails on Safari" labels=bug
add issue comment octo/app#5 "Thanks, looking into it"
assign copilot octo/app#5 rationale="Well-scoped bug with clear repro" confidence=HIGH
suggest copilot octo/app#5 rationale="Small isolated change" confidence=MEDIUM
create pr octo/app "Fix login" head=fix-login base=main reviewers=alice,bob
update pr octo/app#7 title="Fix login flow" draft=false
add pr comment octo/app#7 "LGTM after CI passes"
create review octo/app#7 event=REQUEST_CHANGES body="Please add tests"
submit review octo/app#7 event=COMMENT body="See inline notes"
add review comment octo/app#7 src/a.go "Use a constant" type=LINE line=42 side=RIGHT
create label octo/app bug color=d73a4a description="Something broken"
update label octo/app bug new=defect color=ff0000
update gist aa5a315d61ae9438b18d filename=notes.md content="new text"
get job logs octo/app 789012 tail=200 content=true
get failed job logs octo/app 456789 content=true
get project status update octo 3 PVTSU_abc
add project item octo 3 octo/app#12 type=issue
create project status update octo 3 status=ON_TRACK body="All good"
create project view octo 3 name=Board layout=board
update project view octo 3 PVTV_abc name=Sprint

commands.usage: create iteration field <owner> <project_number> name= duration=<days> start=YYYY-MM-DD
commands.example: create iteration field octo 3 name=Sprint duration=14 start=2026-01-05
list rule suites octo/app level=repository time=day
create ruleset octo/app "Protect main" level=repository enforcement=active rules='[{"type":"deletion"}]'
